The '''Artillery Droid AR-19''' was a model of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] manufactured by the [[Okara Droid Company]]. A number of AR-19 units were deployed to protect the Research and Development section at the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].
